title: 100-Mode Rotated Gaussian Grid (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `rotated100` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Rotates the 10x10 Gaussian grid off the coordinate axes to verify that a trainer's 100-mode recovery is geometrically invariant and not exploiting axis-aligned separability.
failure_mode: Axis-biased quantizers, separable coordinate heuristics, or poorly conditioned generators leave bridge mass along rotated diagonals and miss precision or covariance gates.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `rotated100` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
